title: KetchUp: an open-source Rust/WebGPU SketchUp alternative for the browser
summary: KetchUp is an open-source, browser-based SketchUp alternative built with Rust and WebGPU, available at ketchup3d.github.io/app. The Hacker News discussion treats it as an early-stage project: commenters report mouse-only navigation and ask for feature showcases on the landing page. The item provides no version number, release date, or detailed feature list, so its current capabilities and compatibility are not established here.
